title: CF Meet Contact Vault bodies v1
description: Request and response bodies of the Contact Vault (Part D sections 31-33). The raw telephone number appears ONLY in the create / update request bodies, which are sent directly to Privacy Relay with a Contact Vault access token; every response is the safe ProtectedContact. The root accepts exactly one of the bodies (fixtures).

CreateContactRequest.description: Protect a telephone number (Contact Vault access token with privacy.contacts.write). Verification, status, fingerprints, key versions and scope are not inputs.

telephoneNumber.description: The raw telephone number: E.164 ("+…") or a national number with defaultCountry. Digits and spaces, "+", "-", ".", "(" and ")" only (no URI scheme, extension or letters). This member exists ONLY in the Contact Vault raw-input bodies; it is never returned and never accepted by any other CF Meet API.

defaultCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country used only to canonicalize a number written without the international prefix.

UpdateContactRequest.description: Replace the telephone value of a contact (same ContactReference, version + 1, verification reset to UNVERIFIED).

telephoneNumber.description: The raw telephone number: E.164 ("+…") or a national number with defaultCountry. Digits and spaces, "+", "-", ".", "(" and ")" only (no URI scheme, extension or letters). This member exists ONLY in the Contact Vault raw-input bodies; it is never returned and never accepted by any other CF Meet API.

defaultCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country used only to canonicalize a number written without the international prefix.

DisableContactRequest.description: Disable a contact (restrictive; allowed while the Contact Vault is disabled).

ProtectedContact.description: The SAFE representation of a protected contact: never the number, ciphertext, nonce, fingerprint or key version.

voice.description: Voice capability; UNKNOWN unless a trusted source established it (never inferred from syntax).
